findings.summary: vi.mock specifiers use .ts extension while the production imports they shadow use .js (../../db/client.js, ../../shared/env.js, ./tokens.js)
findings.suggested_fix: Change vi.mock('../../db/client.ts'), vi.mock('../../shared/env.ts'), vi.mock('./tokens.ts') to the .js specifiers so they literally match the production import strings

findings.summary: auth.login parses request body via c.req.json() with no try/catch; malformed JSON surfaces as a non-AppError SyntaxError and the errorHandler maps it to 500 INTERNAL rather than 400/422
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap `await c.req.json()` in try/catch and throw `new ValidationError('Malformed JSON body')` on parse failure so the client gets a 422 with a meaningful code

findings.summary: AuthRouterVars.user.role is typed as plain string; contracts/auth.ts defines role as z.enum(['patient','doctor']) and could narrow the variable type
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `user: { userId: string; role: string }` with `user: { userId: string; role: 'patient' | 'doctor' }` or a type derived from contracts UserShape

findings.summary: wireAuth uses Hono<any> with a biome-ignore suppression instead of a shared AppEnv generic, weakening end-to-end variable typing across mounted routes
findings.suggested_fix: Introduce a shared AppEnv type in apps/api/src/main.ts (or shared/types.ts) and replace `Hono<any>` with `Hono<AppEnv>`; drop the biome-ignore

findings.summary: Token module is mocked wholesale; unit suite never exercises the real session-token mint/verify path
findings.suggested_fix: Acceptable for unit scope — rely on tokens.test.ts (wave-4) and integration tests for end-to-end coverage; no action required here
